notes.title: Zero Caliber devblog - 1 year anniversary and the upcoming update
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

Our beloved shooter will soon celebrate its official [b]1-year anniversary[/b]!
Zero Caliber was released in Early Access on 9th November, 2018, but it was born a little bit earlier - the first playable builds came into existence around this time 1 year ago.. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/6cfd0596ac853818d53f6e6939a89dd2ecbc30d1.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this, the upcoming update and the upcoming PvP’s beta - which is getting closer and closer by the day (probably December) - we’ve decided to have a 1-week-long sale for the first time since the game's launch. 
[i]Pro tip: might be a good time to get into the game and practice so you can jump into PvP as a veteran when the time comes. ;)[/i]

I’ve also put together a short list with all the goodies that are coming in the next update - the main new feature will be [b]player customization![/b]
Detailed patch notes are coming alongside the update, which is [b][strike]scheduled to go live around the 1st of October[/strike][/b] - re-scheduled to go live later (hopefully around 11 Oct. at the latest) due to optimization issues with the skin system.

[i]Images shown below showcase WiP states and are subject to change.[/i]

[h1]PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION | RANK ICONS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/c71d6c7cf15051775b4751dbc7fa85f03d61e03e.jpg[/img]

After introducing weapon skins, we’ve started to experiment with [b]custom player skins[/b] and [b]accessories[/b]. The first batch of custom items will make it into the update: a mix of serious military equipment and goofy items just for the fun of it. :)
[i]The items/skins will be unlockable through the progression system, or can be found hidden throughout all maps.[/i] 

We’ve also reworked the rank names and icons - because who doesn’t want to show off his/her hard earned rank?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33118351/3ccb0d36691acc86f0d6f83b939bd2df6278f441.jpg[/img]

[h1]WEAPONS | RECOIL REBALANCE[/h1]

A lot of you requested a recoil update on all weapons: it is happening! 
Every weapon got [b]unique recoil behaviours[/b] in order to balance them out better - [i]this balance will be vital in PvP as well[/i].
The Uzi, P90 and the BAR got double mags (which are now fixed and work correctly), while the M4A1, Python and P90 got new weapon skins. 

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]

There’s now a [b]confirmation window on the death screen[/b] before returning to the lobby - hopefully this will stop accidental exits from a session.
We’ve also added an [b]option to have the mic always on[/b] - this will be useful for VR Arcades, and for regular players as well who doesn’t like turning the radio on every time they want to tell something. 

[h1]RELOAD AND CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

We’ve improved the way of interacting with attachments [i](more on this in the final patch notes)[/i] and made it easier to remember to reload weapons: if hints are enabled, the sliders will be [b]highlighted[/b] if there is no shell chambered - a helpful hint to remind you to reload your weapon.
Sprinting with heavier weapons like snipers and the BAR is now possible again.

[h1]SOUNDS[/h1]

We’ve updated the audio engine to its latest version which means improved soundscapes, dynamic movement sounds and all kinds of improvements all around.

---

Besides the things mentioned above, numerous fixes and improvements are also coming in the update. 
The update after this one will probably focus on bugfixes and polish, but you can expect new content as well, plus a new, updated tutorial map. 
PvP alongside dedicated servers are in the works, we’ll soon tune in with more information about the planned beta and everything you need to know.

After one year we still have a lot to do, we’re still full of plans and ideas! We’ll see how well we can manage our time. :) 
Thank you all for the continuous support and patience! 

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - Index Controller and WMR joystick support, Touch toggle-grip, massive performance boost + hotfix n°2!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

We've been quite busy after July's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/877200/announcements/detail/1589127074034701443]content update[/url]. It unfortunately introduced a few bugs that needed to be fixed as soon as possible. 
The first hotfix went live [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/877200/announcements/detail/1589127960896688598]two weeks ago[/url], and now with this hotfix we're hoping that we managed to fix all the major bugs of the update. 

But, you know us.. it wouldn't be us if we didn't cram even more stuff into one update. :) 
As a result, Zero Caliber now has full [b]Index Controller support[/b] (except for finger tracking) and [b]native WMR joystick support[/b]. [b]Oculus Touch[/b] controllers got the awaited [b]toggle-grip option[/b] and as a bonus, [b]performance got increased by at least 20%[/b]*!
[i]*mostly noticeable in combat situations[/i]

[h1]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Valve Index Controller support[/b]
[i]Attention! The 'bolt catch' and 'magazine release' buttons are hand-dependant. Right controller buttons work on weapons held in the right hand, left controller buttons work on weapons held in the left hand.[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Content Update - New map, new weapon, weapon skins, loadout storing system, sharper graphics & countless more goodies!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We have two, very very busy months behind us. As a result, we can proudly present [b]Zero Caliber’s biggest, most packed content update[/b] since its EA release last year! 
We’ve brought you a[b] new map - Lockup[/b], a [b]new weapon - Glock 18[/b], the much-awaited [b]loadout storing system[/b], unlockable [b]weapon skins[/b], sharper graphics and a lot, lot more! 
[i]Really, when i say a lot more, i mean [b]A LOT[/b] more. [/i]

[b]This update is a HUGE one, please read through all the patchnotes below to see the full picture.[/b] 
It’s impossible to summarize all the new content and improvements in a few words. 

[h1]MAPS[/h1]
[list]
[*] New mission: [b]Lockup[/b]. [i]The Tlalokii have overtaken a maximum security prison. You're tasked with the covert mission of recovering sensitive prisoner lists.[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/3ApkABh.jpg [/img]

[i]NOTE: You can find a basketball court mid-mission with functioning basketballs. Because even soldiers have to relax mid-combat.[/i] 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/h8mV7eVmzU1PCFKODm/giphy.gif [/img]

[/list]

[h1]WEAPON SKINS | REWORKED LOBBY
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Extended Armory[/b]: with the amount of weapons and skins we have, it was time to extend our armory with new weapon racks, and a shooting range [i](which is still WiP)[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/ZK6FF1E.jpg [/img]

[*] The new weapon racks contain [b]all the available weapons[/b], their [b]skins[/b], [b]all the attachments[/b] and their [b]skins [/b]and [b]all types of magazines[/b]. And their skins. Yes. All of them.
[i]NOTE: You can choose which weapon skin you prefer and all the corresponding items will use that skin.[/i]
[*] [b]Unlocking weapon skins[/b]: each skin has a [b]rank requirement[/b] you have to reach. There are also [b]hidden mystery skins throughout all maps[/b] [i](if treasure hunting is your thing - yarr!)[/i]; they can only be unlocked by [b]finding them[/b]. 
[/list]

[h1]NEW LOADOUT STORING SYSTEM
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Store your favourite loadouts![/b]
You now have access to[b] 3 life-size mannequins[/b] to store your favourite loadouts on.
You can manually suit up your doppelgängers with your favourite setups, [b]OR [/b]you can just press the appropriate buttons (either to store or to equip) to make the process faster.

[i]Store your gear, and they'll be waiting for you next time you launch the game.[/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/ZErERfhMCRykINabVM/giphy.gif [/img]
[/list] 

[h1]WEAPONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New weapon: the Glock 18[/b], a legendary fully-automatic pistol. 
[i]Did i mention it also has a drum mag? Brrrrt.[/i]

[img] https://i.imgur.com/24GIZ5z.jpg [/img]

[*] Tactical shield level-up: when using [b]a pistol and shield combo[/b], you can reload one-handed for that extra badass feeling!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TdcE8LnVRKq0bDKe7h/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] [b]Burst fire mode[/b] added for the following weapons: G36 [i](double shot)[/i], Glock 18 [i](triple shot)[/i] and the KRISS Vector [i](double shot)[/i]
[*] Most weapons have [b]multiple new types of magazines[/b]: extended, double, drum, etc.
[*] All magazines have skinned versions and you can combine them with different weapon skins
[*] Grenades now have [b]indicator trails[/b] when thrown, with lights and sound effect
[*] [b]Shotgun clips[/b] can be used for easier reload: load 5 shells in at a time, then keep taking clips out of your ammo pouch instead of individual shells.
[i]NOTE: Why have shotguns without proper reload mechanics? Good question! 
Pumpable shotguns are finally coming in the next update! [/i]
[*] The last 15 weapons you’ve grabbed won’t disappear within a ~32m radius 
[*] Revolver ejects bullets/casings correctly
[*] Turret release by distance fixed
[*] Stocks dynamically open or close depending on which state is closer [i](instead of always opening unless completely closed)[/i]
[*] G36 stock now works as intended
[/list]

[h1]ATTACHMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Attention! The way of removing attachments has changed![/b] 
Press and hold the trigger, then pull the attachment away [i](no need to use button combinations anymore)[/i]. 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/H9Cz5sk.jpg [/img]

A short trigger press (no holding!) without pulling your hand away will change the modes on the attachment if applicable. 
[u]WITH UNDER BARREL GRIPS[/u]: Little bit different, you have to secondary grab the weapon (grip) - then press the trigger and pull the attachment away to remove it. 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/lommC9J.jpg [/img]

[i]NOTE: Knocking off an attachment with another one still works![/i]
[*] Smart attachment interaction when pressing the corresponding button - action performed in this order: 
1. Release slider IF backed
2. Activate side attachment IF there is one on the weapon AND the slider isn’t backed
3. Activate scope IF the slider isn’t backed AND there is no side attachment
[*] Attachment optimization resulting in much better performance
[*] Silencers can be removed from pistols
[*] Flash suppressor now works as intended
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY | AI
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Smarter AI behavior[/b]: the enemy will change states, run in and out of cover, run away or charge you depending on the situation around them 
[i]NOTE: Friendly AI will get a rework soon![/i]
[*] AI spawn optimization resulting in better performance
[*] Loading screen added
[/list]

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
[list]
[*] Holster improvement: can’t remove other players’ holstered weapons. 
[i]No more stealing. :’([/i] 
[*] Reviving other players isn’t instant anymore, it has a small (1 sec) cooldown.
[*] Force pull sync improved
[*] Improved weapon spawning to hand
[/list]
	
[h1]PLAYER | CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trigger/grip interaction: we've separated what the trigger and grip buttons can do:
Trigger: ammo and attachment interaction
Grip: weapon grabbing
[*] [b]Reloading while crouching[/b]: it is now easier to take out ammo from the belt while crouching [i](ammo pouch collider is around the player’s knees when crouching) [/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/h3oKMalixN0g5YdDLO/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] Wrist and lower arm positioning and rotations are reworked
[i]NOTE: It is much better than before, but still WiP.[/i]
[*] UI laser beam improved: it is now independent from weapon length
[*] Completely [b]reworked Comfort Mode[/b] setting for players prone to motion sickness - it is much more pleasant now. Also we now have three intensity settings under Settings>Game
[*] Comfort mode setup added to Lobby
[*] Player doesn’t glitch anymore when pressing full locomotion immediately after spawning
[*] Various force pull bug fixes
[*] Menu and pointer now supports main hand setting for left handed players

[i]NOTE: Index controllers are not supported officially. It's coming in the next update![/i]
[/list]

[h1]GFX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sharpened image to reduce overall blurriness - MUCH more sharp graphics 

[img] https://i.imgur.com/BqHBzoB.jpg [/img]

[*] No more head- and armless body after player death
[*] POIs are now fading when the player looks towards them - less obstructing
[*] Menu UI scaled down
[*] Impact decals are now attached to dynamic objects
[*] In the menu, after pressing Exit to Desktop, Cancel button now works
[*] New map has an experimental GFX feature (on VR platform): lens flares [i](bless Michael Bay!)[/i]
[*] ‘Retaliation’ map got the 'american-night' filter: instead of pitch-black, it has a nice blue ambient atmosphere
[*] Overall post processing FX improvements
[/list] 

[h1]SFX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated gun sounds
[*] Burst weapon tail sound fixed, sound echoes after every burst even if the player doesn’t let go of the trigger
[/list]

----

Phew, what a list! 
As you can see, we went a little overboard with all the things we wanted to pack into this update. It took a little longer than we wanted to, but we made it! - well, almost made it. 
We’re aware this update isn’t completely bug free. [b]Currently these are the bugs we know about, they will be fixed in a hotfix coming in the next few days.[/b]
[list]
[*] PSO scope disappears from the weapon rack under the Dragunov
[*] [strike]Co-op: if a squadmate finds a mystery skin then the whole squad recieves the skin[/strike]
[*] Reloading weapons which were taken off the mannequins: several magazines get stuck at the belt
[*] End of 'Lockup' chopper scene shakes the camera unnecessarily
[*] 'Lockup' checkpoints: respawning at checkpoints takes a bit too long because of the map's loading time
[*] Incorrect impact decals are displayed on walls when shot at from some weapons
[*] Picking up random weapons and grabbing them in the secondary hand position makes the hand invisible in some cases
[/list]

If you encounter any other bugs, please head over to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/1/]Bugreports[/url] section and report them - [i]we read ALL the reports, even if we don't answer immediately[/i]. 

We're eagerly waiting for your feedback about this update - please share your thoughts with us on either of the platforms listed in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/877200/discussions/2/1681441347870749327/]Contact Us[/url] topic. 

---

That's all for now, go and have fun! :)
And thank you for the continuous support and patience, it's really appreciated!

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

[i]We’re sorry for the delay, we had to fix some unforeseen bugs before being able to release it. [/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber devblog: what will the next update bring? New weapons, skins, OST & more!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone! [/b]

Another month, another update is approaching. 
This time we’re focusing on core gameplay features like the much awaited [b]weapon skin system[/b], [b]loadout save system[/b], a new [b]cover system[/b] for the AI, [b]two new weapons[/b]: the BAR and Beretta with unique skins and a game soundtrack.

[b]You can expect the new update to go live within 2 weeks. [/b]

Here’s what we’re planning to include in the update:
[i]Disclaimer: all images, gifs and videos seen below show WiP states and don’t represent their final state![/i]

[h1]2 new weapons! [/h1]

Many of you were asking for a WW2 inspired weapon. We chose the [b]BAR[/b]! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/7291bf0251e2f5335a5c1108bb51b5b27eade4c1.jpg[/img]

We’ve also added another community favourite weapon: the Beretta. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/4c8b1eddec51dd5082df498731f68ae161ba535c.jpg[/img]

Both weapons are coming with unique, beautiful [b]skins[/b] which can be unlocked by reaching the required rank. This brings up a new feature we’ve been working on… 

[h1]Weapon skin system! [/h1]

Currently the only way you can obtain unique skinned weapons is if you find a hidden weapon on one of the maps and you keep it with you at all times. 
[b]That’s about to change! [/b]
We’re introducing the [b]weapon skin system[/b]:
[list]
[*] you’ll be able to unlock skins by ranking up [i](same as with weapons and attachments)[/i]
[*] you’ll be able to equip any skin you previously unlocked for a particular weapon in the reworked armory before going to combat
[/list]
[b]This way you’ll never lose your favourite skin again![/b]

[h1]Loadout saving system[/h1]

You like switching between different loadouts depending on your current mood? We got you!
You’ll be able to save different loadouts, then equip yourself with them in an instant.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/3ec45fe7f8bd50d921b69fb0989fc178e65398b9.png[/img]

We’ve once again sent our AI back to military school. They’ve learnt how to use covers!
[b]Expect a much smarter and more challenging AI to fight![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gKx9pUN3k2bFg9vkNA/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]

We’ve been composing an original soundtrack for the game, it is now time to implement it. You can listen to a short sample of it here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wAnGUOUQwaQ

In Co-op mode you might’ve noticed that your Co-op mate’s animations aren’t as fluid. We’ve improved it a lot by adding animations (crouching, prone etc.) so your teammate’s movement will look much better and smoother.

These are the main features the next update will include, the detailed patchnotes will accompagny the update itself. 
[b]Are you guys as excited as we are? [/b]

Follow our Facebook page and join our Discord server if you don’t want to miss additional content about the upcoming update! 
https://www.facebook.com/XREALGamesVR
https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

The much awaited mid-April content update is live!

[list]

[*] Improved hand positions for all magazines

[*] Fixed: pistol magazines can not be knocked out with other magazines anymore - can only be released with the release button.
[/list]

[h1]Attachments[/h1]

[list]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/Pio1zws09u57N7VECs/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] Similarly, you can now knock out mags with any other mag you find, doesn’t have to be the same type.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New AI animations[/b]: enemy- and teammate AI got better animations, their movement is much more smooth and fluid. Their behaviour is also improved. 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/hvkQVv7VjTD6nvM73K/giphy.gif [/img]

[*] [b]Difficulty dependant AI accuracy[/b]: the AI is now more accurate in hard difficulty, less so in normal- and easy.
[*] More challenging enemies on normal and hard difficulties.
[*] Increased the amount of XP per level, so you can [b]gain ranks faster[/b].
[*] [b]Start Next Level button[/b] now resets the next mission and starts it from the beginning in single player mode.
[/list]

[h1]Gfx[/h1]

[list]
[*] Rain effect on the new map
[*] Tons of graphical optimizations
[/list]

[h1]Sounds[/h1]

[list]
[*] Minor sfx update
[/list]

---

The player belt change and the AI overhaul are both [b]significant changes[/b], please send your feedback our way here on Steam, on Discord or via e-mail!
[b]If you encounter any bugs, please report them in the 'Bugreports' section.[/b] 

As always, thank you all for your support, keep the suggestions and feedback coming!

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - Steyr AUG, Movement changes, Initial setup guide, FPS independent recoil and a lot lot more!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys! 
[/b]

Since the last update, we've been working very hard on fixing core issues, and optimizing the game's performance. 
We haven't forgotten about content either, another community favourite weapon got added: the [b]Steyr AUG[/b] with new attachment and surprises! 
You'll see a new, initial setup guide to help you choose the settings of your liking.


[i]It's hard to summarize all the improvements, fixes and content, so please do read the patchnotes below. [/i]

[h1]Player / control improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Player movement changes:
- Increased top speed while running
- Slower base speed, slower strafing, slower going backwards
- Slower crouch and prone speed
- Player can only run when not aiming (depending on weapon type)
- Run can be automatically, or by-input activated (can be set in the options menu)
[*] [b]Fixed disappearing weapon slot[/b]
[*] [b]Initial Setup Menu added:[/b] it will pop up only at the first launch after this update: players are introduced to some of our most critical and useful settings
[*] Improved main hand-, and trigger pulling finger animation
[*] Player body stays on the ground after dying
[*] Force pull fixed after lever release
[*] Player weapon grab on death fixed
[/list]

[h1]Gfx and optimization[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Benchmark Feature under graphics settings: Auto-Set your game to 90 fps any time![/b]
[*] Optimized weapon and attachment textures (smaller size, same quality)
[*] Lobby armory performance optimizations
[*] All scopes and crosshairs have sharper reticle now
[*] Significant Disk Size improvement of the Packaged Game (From 30 GB to 15 GB)
[*] ‘Retaliation’ lighting iteration: brightened up some dark spots of the map
[*] Fixed ‘Retaliation’ foliage lighting errors
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/d4424c945338a132721eceb57bd36954d92773a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Steyr AUG[/b] bullpup assault rifle with new attachments.[i] Check the unlock requirements in the new info panel![/i]
[*] [b]New info panel[/b] added to the armory, showing the rank [b]requirements for unlocking[/b] each weapon and attachment 
[*] [b]Improved, frame rate independent recoil[/b]
[*] New skins hidden on different maps (The first community skins, courtesy of [b]Koretskyy[/b]. Thank you mate!)
[*] Weapon and skin unlock fixes
[*] Projectile spawning is synced from client to server
[*] Improved hand poses: Better primary gripping of weapons, improved mag holding poses
[*] Lasersight improvements: lit when playing on high quality. A flare indicates its position when enemy holds his weapon directly at player
[*] Scopes zoom levels changed, now all scopes can be used in Close-to-Mid range combat scenarios. Default zoom has the widest FOV.
[/list]

[h1]Attachments[/h1]

[list]
[*] WiP, experimental attachments hidden as easter eggs in different maps [i](Magnified Holo Sight, HAMR Hybrid Scope, Canted Iron Sights Rail, Drum Kit Mag for Kriss Vector)[/i]
[*] 2 new laser attachments with new colors
[*] Bipod: players are now able to use it as a vertical grip
[*] Improved lasersight positions because of the new laser attachments
[*] Laser sight visual is same for teammates and allies
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]

[list]
[*] The first story map, ‘Timber’ is divided into 2 parts with reworked layout and gameplay. Previously this map was huge, which negatively affected performance. 
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*] Co-op: respawn grab fixed on client side
[*] Co-op: weapon drop from hand upon player death improved
[*] Co-op: floating weapons on player leave fix
[*] [b]AI: reworked targeting and aiming system for more balanced fights[/b]
[/list]

[i]Unfortunately, some of our AIs decided to chase butterflies instead of shooting, so we had to delay the implementation of the new animations. We're fixing the bugs, but we need more time to sort it out. Will be included in a later update, we're sorry about it. [/i]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/FsUrWEv7QSeJvqCCDc/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Sounds[/h1]

[list]
[*] Updated semi gun sounds.
[/list]

---

As you can see, we've been focusing on fixing and improving things. Bugs might still occur, if you see anything unusual, please report it in the 'Bugreports' section here on Steam, or via our Discord server.
Your help is greatly appreciated! 
If you have any suggestions, ideas, contact us here, via e-mail, social media or Discord, we're all ears!

[b]New maps, the PvP mode and further improvements are in development, stay tuned for the news about them! [/b]

[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber news - mini devblog and the next update's release date
notes.content:
[b]Hey all, [/b]

We hope you guys are all wondering when and what will be the next step for Zero Caliber en route to its full release.
We know we still have a long road ahead of us, but with all the great feedback and suggestions we could gather from the community already, our team is now working harder than ever to make the game just like you all want it to be!

The [b]next update[/b] will be a [b]major one[/b], scheduled [b]around 15th March[/b]. 

[b]What can you expect from this update? [/b]

[i]Disclaimer: all footage seen below are from the testing phase and don't represent their release state.[/i]

[h1]First part of a massive AI overhaul[/h1]

Our AI [i]-both enemy and teammate-[/i] isn’t perfect. We know that. Our team has been working very hard to bring new life to AI behaviour and animations and we are eager to show you its result!
Although still far from final, their behaviour will be much more lifelike: they received proper animations, be it regular movement, reloading, cover finding or aiming. 
That, combined with a reworked aiming system means that they will move much more smoothly, and will behave more like a human instead of their current choppy nature. 
We still need a lot of internal testing and bugfixing, but you can expect to fight a much more intelligent enemy starting from the next update! 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/dYB3oibfFkTUDnAZmc/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Improved and fine tuned movement system to avoid possible motion sickness[/h1]

Zero Caliber is one of the more intense titles out there when it comes to movement. This means that people prone to VR induced motion sickness might feel a little dizzy after longer play sessions. 
We’ve already implemented a so called ‘Comfort mode’ to counter this (found in the options menu), as well as started to even out the terrain to avoid frequent and sudden up and down movements. 
In the next update, you’ll see a few changes, namely: 
[list]
[*] Slower base speed, slower strafing, slower backward speed
[*] Slower speed when crouching
[*] Player can only run when not aiming (depending on weapon type)
[*] Run can be automatically or by-input activated (can be set in the options menu)
[/list]

[i]We are hoping that this change will further help in countering motion sickness, and will also give a more realistic movement feel.[/i]

[h1]‘Timber’ rework[/h1]

The game’s first campaign map, ‘Timber’ is currently very demanding performance wise. People with weaker PCs might experience FPS drops due to the huge gameplay area and all the details that can be seen at the same time. 
We’ve decided to change the map’s layout. The mission’s length and aesthetics will remain the same, but the overall performance will be much more optimized across all the mission. 

[h1]Initial setup guide[/h1]

The game has a lot of options, which can all be found in the settings menu. To make things easier for players, we’ve implemented a setup guide, which will pop at the first start of the game (and can be skipped for experienced players). 
This quick setup guide will help players to select the optimal graphical settings, preferred locomotion type (head or hand oriented, left or right hand, snap or smooth turn) and other important settings.
All these settings can be adjusted later in the options menu, but inexperienced players will have an easier time setting up the game in order to achieve the best experience possible.

[h1]Better hand animations[/h1]

We’ve also improved the player’s hand animations. Pulling the trigger and reloading the guns will feel much more natural!

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/3q4Qqii8tYkbSR6wgd/giphy.gif [/img]

[h1]Steyr AUG[/h1]

Our weapon selection will be expanded with yet another community favourite: the [b]Steyr AUG[/b] bullpup [b]assault rifle[/b]. 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/55rS2RtlQVZA5hm6Ns/giphy.gif [/img]


Based on your feedback, and the fact that we want to polish Zero Caliber as much as possible, we’ve decided to concentrate more on core mechanics and gameplay improvements for this update. 
This of course doesn’t mean we’ll leave you without content updates! We’re also already working on two new singleplayer/coop maps that will be released a bit later. 
The list of things we’re working on doesn’t stop here! 
Our PvP mode is in the works too, we’re expecting a [b]beta-ready state next month[/b]! Are you guys excited? We surely are and will count on all your feedback in this stage more than ever!
[i]We’ll keep you guys posted about future updates as we progress.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/13e7500b096ee89b7d95bbd9273ec726b70c94d5.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions/request/advice, feel free to contact us here on Steam, on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/xrealgames]r/xrealgames[/url], on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/R5ZUsjB]Discord[/url] or our social media channels any time!

[b]Thank you guys for your continuous support, and again, as we make the game for you it is essential to keep every feedback coming![/b]

[i]Daniel
XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - New night map, attachments on AI weapons, improved progression system and a lot more!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys! 
[/h1]

We've been hearing a lot from the community that Zero Caliber needs a CQB map, so we made one! 
Our new small mission, [b]'Retaliation'[/b] brings you intense [b]Close Quarters Battles[/b], and what is even better is that it's a night map! 
Grab your flashlight attachment, put it onto your favourite gun, and you're good to go! Or don't, and enjoy the darkness. It's your call. 
[b]'Retaliation' can be unlocked by replaying 'Boot Camp'. 
[/b] 

[i]Check out the detailed patchnotes below.
[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/4fa9c8fef92d109d34b03e156c45ae76d3b63ae9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Missions[/h1]
[list]
[*] New level: [b]Retaliation [/b] - [i]Unlocks after replaying 'Boot Camp'[/i]
[*] Reworked music for lobby
[/list]

[h1]Player/control improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Better VR experience: we removed the collision from most of the small objects, so your movement will be smoother - [i]less likely to experience heavy motion sickness[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Attachments on AI weapons:[/b] the AI is now using weapons equipped with various attachments. [i]Check out the fallen AI's weapons and take any attachment you want![/i]
[*] Minor fixes on various guns
[/list]

[h1]Progression system[/h1]

XP, player rank and weapon-unlock system improvements [i][previously the player unlocked weapons at the end of levels, only once][/i]:
[list]
[*] Players now get *XP* points for completing levels
[*] Better accuracy, more kills and headshots, plus more co-op buddies mean more XP!
[*] XP points get *Ranks* for players
[*] With each rank, players unlock some weapons, special magazines or attachments
[*] Fortunately, [b]previously unlocked[/b] and/or bought [b]weapons[/b], [b]magazines or attachments are kept[/b], not lost with this update
[*] What is more, previously skipped weapons get unlocked automatically if current player rank allows them
[*] [b]Known issue: unique weapon skins are not handled yet, will be added in a future update[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Totally reworked enemy spawning (improved and more balanced)
[*] The enemy uses attachments on weapons too
[*] The friendly ai will use more weapons with better attachments
[*] Various bugfixes on every level
[/list]

[h1]Gfx[/h1]
[list]
[*] Effect, texture model fixes 
[*] Optimization on multiple levels
[/list]

[h1]Stuff we're currently working on
[/h1]
[list]
[*] A massive AI overhaul [both animation and behaviour]
[*] Pump acion shotguns
[*] New maps
[*] PvP [more info soon™, please be patient :)]
[*] Optimization and fixes
[/list]

[b]As always, thank you guys for the continuous support and feedback, it's greatly appreciated! 
Keep the feedback and suggestions coming! [/b]

[i]- XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: What to expect from Zero Caliber VR in 2019 + new trailer!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

We’d like to share with you what you can expect from the XREAL Games Team regarding Zero Caliber VR in 2019. :)

TL;DR version:
[list]
[*] Monthly map updates
[*] Regular weapon updates
[*] Massive AI overhaul, both animation- and behaviour wise
[*] PvP with dedicated servers
[*] Tutorial and weapon showcase videos
[*] Reworked progression and unlock system
[*] Complete dialogue and voice acting rework
[*] Conclusion of the story
[*] Soundtrack
[*] Massive optimization improvements
[/list]

[b]Last year was a blast![/b] Thanks to the community’s feedback, suggestions and bugreports, the game has come a long way! We’ve been working constantly on fixing, polishing the game and adding new content, and [b]we will continue to do so in 2019[/b]! 
[i]We’re still a small indie team of enthusiast developers, so your continuous support means a lot to us! :) [/i]

[b]Please welcome our new trailer![/b] Subscribe to [strike]Pewdi[/strike] our channel for the upcoming weapon showcase- and tutorial videos!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02Wnp6KuTyQ

[h1]And now on to 2019: we won’t leave you without updates! 
[/h1]

You can expect monthly map updates, the first one coming at the end of next week. Are you afraid in the dark? We hope not! ;) 
It will be a smaller mission, just like ‘Dust’ and ‘Frostbite’. The flashlight attachment might come in handy! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/df22f5cb3e533c4cb9462ad316aea961b1482afa.jpg[/img]

Between the map updates, there will be [b]regular new weapon additions[/b]. We’ve already added a community favourite, the KRISS Vector. Let us know which one should we add next! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/0b3f294e3aed009c6055483fa46501223f7d1a3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI[/h1]

We have to talk about the dreaded AI. We know it isn’t perfect, but don’t worry! It will get a complete overhaul.[b] New animations and behaviour updates are on the way! [/b]

[h1]PvP fans shouldn’t be let down either! [/h1]

We’ve started working on the [b]PvP mode[/b] of Zero Caliber VR. Our vision is to bring something new to the market, we’ll share the details when we get closer to testing around [b]April[/b]. Stay tuned! 

[h1]Graphics[/h1]

In terms of VR, optimization is key. We have a few tricks in our bag, graphics and performance will get better and better with each update! We’ve already decreased the blurriness in our latest update and will continue to optimize the game even better!

[h1]Story and Gameplay
[/h1]

The dialogue, and the voice acting will get an overhaul as well. We do know it isn’t perfect either, we’re reworking it based on the community’s feedback. 
We’re also producing a badass soundtrack for the game, and of course the [b]story will get a conclusion[/b]. 

---

This post is long as it is, so we haven’t listed everything we’re planning to do this year (like the reworked progression and unlock system). If you have any questions, feel free to ask us here on Steam, on[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/xrealgames] r/xrealgames[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/XREALGamesVR/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/xrealgames]Twitter[/url], e-mail or our Discord server. We’re more than happy to answer! 

If you have trouble or issues with the game and need assistance, contact us directly, we’re always there to help! 

[b]On to a very exciting and update-filled 2019! :)
[/b]
[i]XREAL Games Team [/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - New map, M14, Comfort mode & a lot more!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

[i]'Tis the season to be jolly! [/i] The Holidays are coming, and we prepared a little surprise for you. 
In this update, you'll find a [b]new, snowy mission: Frostbite[/b] with a present: a [b]tactical shield[/b] hidden somewhere on the map. It's for testing purposes, please send us feedback! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/5fca4109f8ec72e3a8d322be370956cd93dc811f.jpg[/img]

We implemented a much awaited weapon: the [b]M14[/b]. You suggested, we made it happen! 
[b]Comfort mode[/b] is also here, hopefully it will help those who suffer from motion-sickness! 

We fixed and improved countless things thanks to your overwhelmingly positive feedback and suggestions. Thank you guys for all the feedback, keep them coming! 
Detailed patchnotes below: 

[h1]Player / control improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added “[b]Comfort mode[/b]”, which you can enable via the options menu. This adds a black fade on the edges of your view if you are moving too fast. This way we hope you can avoid VR sickness.
[*] Added “[b]VR Center Arrow[/b]”, which you can enable via the options menu. This will indicate the center of your roomscale VR setup.
[*] In Co-op mode now you can view your [b]stats[/b] with the long press of the ‘option’ button.
[*] Improved weapon pick up for oculus
[*] Grenades can be [b]cooked [/b]with top action button (no need to pull out pin manually)
[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

[list]
[*] New M14 Rifle
[*] Winter Camo
[*] Red Dot with Darkened Sight designed specifically for bright levels
[*] New Tactical [b]Shield [/b](hidden on Frostbite level)
[*] [url=https://media.giphy.com/media/3htQg3lf72vj0rOauF/giphy.gif] Slap slider release for MP5s ([b]H&K Slap Reload[/b])	[/url]
[*] Glock scope attach fix
[*] Side attachments for AWP
[*] Weapon recoil drop to slot fix
[*] Projectile particle optimization
[*] Authentic PSO crosshair
[/list]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved Projectile Visuals, more variated look between the different calibers
[*] Improved Performance on ‘Comfort’
[*] ‘Comfort’ and ‘Timber’ Environment fixes
[*] Pixel density setting slider fixed: previously it was set to default regardless of the selected value - crispier graphics when set to high, better performance when set to low
[/list]

[h1]Missions[/h1]

[list]
[*] New level: [b]Frostbite[/b] - [i]replay Boot Camp to get access to it[/i]
[*] Tank, Stryker improved collisions
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*] Optional [b]respawn at checkpoint[/b] in Co-op
[*] Rare crash on 'Comfort' fixed
[*] Occasional crash on 'Timber' fixed
[*] Removed collision with small items on the floor, so the VR experience is smoother
[*] More weapon types for your friendly soldiers
[*] Easier to survive with the [b]Second Wind feature[/b], you have half a sec to move to cover when you are about to die
[*] Sacr stock unlock fixed
[*] Shooting and Clipping through Walls on ‘Timber’ and ‘Comfort’ fixed
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]

[list]
[*] Music can now be turned off
[*] Sound slider bug fixed
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33118351/9eba9610dc2d2d7eafbddf27a43027d09c4790b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Once again thank you guys for all the feedback and suggestions, we couldn't be more thankful! Keep them coming![/b]

notes.title: Zero Caliber Update - SVD Dragunov, auto grip/ungrip & more!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys! [/b]

In this update you'll find a new sniper rifle: the [b]SVD Dragunov[/b] with the PSO scope. 
Auto grip/ungrip got implemented, the previously implemented snap/smooth turn can now be disabled in the control settings and FPS drops while using scope is gone. 
Check the detailed patchnotes below!

[h1]New weapon and attachments:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]SVD Dragunov[/b] Sniper Rifle - with the PSO Scope!
[*] RIS Adapter / PSO scope for AK47, AKM, AS Val
[/list]

[h1]Player/Controls improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Auto grip, auto ungrip by proximity is now available both on Oculus Rift and HTC Vive![/b] Can be turned on/off in the settings menu. 
[*] Option to turn off snap/smooth turn is now available in the settings menu! 
     How to snap/smooth turn?
     [b]Oculus[/b]: On dominant hand (right by default) move joystick left/right 
     and release
     [b]Vive[/b]: On dominant hand (right by default) PRESS left or right quarter of the touchpad
[i]Attention! Input controls changed for HTC Vive and Windows Mixed Reality headsets in the last update:
- Fire mode change (auto, semi, safety): primary hand controller menu button short press
- Attachment release: primary hand controller menu button press-and-hold[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay improvements/changes/fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved gun recoil on every gun (very rarely flies out of your hand, but if you wield an assault rifle one handed, it will be extremely inaccurate) 
[*] Improved gun handling, controller positions
[*] Increased player health on higher difficulties, changed regeneration pattern
[*] Enemy aim adjustments
[*] New armory layout
[*] Changed default weapon unlocks
[*] ‘Forest’ map repeatable helicopter sequence bug fixed
[*] Countless gameplay fixes throughout all levels
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer improvements and fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed crash at Hail level completion[/b]
[*] Player weapon slot is now handled on client side
[*] Stryker firing synced to client side
[*] Wall explosion synced to client side
[/list]
	
[h1]Graphical optimization and fixes:
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Scope optimization: default scope has better performance, also you can set lower resolution, or lower quality scopes too in the Quality Settings - [b]no more fps drops when using scopes! [/b]
[*] Player hit effect optimized (previously it caused huge performance drops on weaker PCs)
[*] Suburbs’ map significant performance and lighting improvements
[*] Minor weapon effect visual improvements	
[*] More visible projectiles: enemies are shooting slightly more visible projectiles for more readable combat
[*] Fixed player’s right wrist’s delayed motion to the controller’s real location
[/list]

[h1]WiP[/h1]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer server list: people from different regions might not find each other’s servers
[*] Occasionally there is no sound on Oculus
[*] AI is constantly being improved
[*] Graphics optimization
[*] [b]Crash on startup with Unreal Engine error: this might be caused by software conflict. 
If you have ASUS sound driver installed: exit from the asus sound driver or end the process with SS2UILauncher.exe. Try to disable the asus sonic sound at startup. 
Nahimic, MSI sound or similar audio apps might also cause a crash.[/b]
[/list]

[i][b]As always, thank you for your continuous support! Share your ideas, suggestions and feedback with us either here on our community hub or on our Discord server![/b][/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber VR - What’s coming? - FAQ
notes.content:
[b] Hey guys! [/b]

We’re aaalmost there! [b] EA release [/b] coming in 15 days, on [b] 9th November! [/b]

While waiting for the release and the demo [coming soon!], prepare yourself by reading this FAQ we made for you. :)

[h1] Important, and frequently asked questions: [/h1]

[b] Q: How much is Zero Caliber VR gonna cost at release? [/b] 
A: $/€ 24.99 with a nice launch discount. 

[b] Q: Will there be voice chat? [/b]
A: Since Zero Caliber VR is a Co-op game, voice chat is a must. It is implemented in the EA version, the demo version does not contain the voice chat feature.

[b] Q: What’s in the demo? Does it have Co-op? [/b]
A: The free demo version contains the tutorial and one standalone mission - fully playable in Co-op! 10 weapons can be unlocked and tried. 

[b] Q: What’s in the EA version? [/b]
A: The EA version contains the tutorial, one standalone mission and the campaign mode - with not just 10, but many more weapons and attachments to be unlocked for your pleasure! Fully playable in Co-op of course.

[b] Q: How many people can play in Co-op? [/b] 
A: You can play the game either alone, or with your buddies: 4 players maximum in Co-op. 

[b] Q: Which VR systems are supported? [/b]
A: HTC Vive, Oculus Rift. WMR is partially supported as well, [i] full, native WMR support is coming in a future update when the WMR joysticks will be added to the party. [/i] Technically the game also supports the Pimax headsets too.

[b] Q: Will there be PvP? [/b]
A: Yes, absolutely! Not at the time of the EA release, though. We’re already working on the PvP mode of Zero Caliber VR, its alpha test is scheduled for Q1, 2019. 

[b] Q: Are there dedicated servers? [/b]
A: Not yet. Co-op works on Host-Client basis.

[h1] Some thoughts about the future of Zero Caliber VR [/h1] 

We’ve been working extremely hard to bring you guys a polished, fully enjoyable game, even in Early Access. 
After the EA release, we’re aiming for [b] monthly content updates [/b]: new weapon and attachment packs one month, then standalone Co-op mission the next month with a bigger, Campaign related update in late Q1, early Q2 next year, which will conclude the story. 
[b] PvP mode is coming as well! [/b] We’ll take extreme care when developing it, as usual. ;) We want it to be THE PvP everyone returns to. Closed Alpha test is scheduled to start late Q1, 2019.

If we haven’t covered your question, head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB] XREAL Games Discord server	[/url] and ask us directly, or post your question in the official Steam topic.

[i] Thank you guys for your continuous support, it keeps us going! [/i]

notes.title: Zero Caliber VR demo version/Alpha Test
notes.content:
[h1] Dear Zero Caliber fans/enthusiasts! [/h1]

[i] [TL;DR at the end] [/i]

We know you are all eagerly waiting for the public demo version of Zero Caliber VR which was originally scheduled to be released on 5 August. 
Learning from our previous mistakes, we have decided to push the demo’s release date back a bit. [b] We don’t want to leave you without Zero Caliber though! Anyone who is interested in testing Zero Caliber can participate in the closed Alpha test to be held in August (starting around the 10th). [/b]
You can sign up for the Closed Alpha test via our Discord: https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB. You’ll find all the details there! 
The fully polished public demo version will be released in [b] early September. [/b] 

[h1] But… why? [/h1]

The reason we’ve decided to push back the demo a bit is that we feel like Zero Caliber isn’t as polished as we’d like it to be. 
When we released our first title, A-Tech Cybernetic, it was way too early in its development. Even though A-Tech evolved immensely since then and we’re getting very positive reviews to this day, the game itself - due to it being released too early - lost a lot of initial interest and visibility. We don’t want to make the same mistake again, players will receive a fully polished demo version of Zero Caliber so everyone can experience it in all its glory as we originally intended. 

[h1] What does this mean? [/h1]

It means that by the time the public demo is released in September, it will be a fully enjoyable and mostly bug-free experience thanks to all the feedback and test results we’ll hopefully get from our Alpha testers. :) 
Don't forget to put Zero Caliber VR on your wishlist so you can catch all the announcements and updates!

[b] TL;DR: Zero Caliber VR public demo release date pushed back to September, Closed Alpha instead in August. Apply on Discord: https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB [/b]

Thank you for understanding, we hope we'll see all of you in our Alpha! ;)
Stay tuned for a fun gameplay teaser coming soon!
